title: Zero Fuss Japanese King Prawns Poke
description: A quick and easy Japanese dish featuring raw king prawns, wood-fired baked vegetables, and a vegetarian friendly sauce, this poke bowl is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: wood-fired baked vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini, bell peppers, and onions

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the vegetables in a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper, then spread them out on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, and grated ginger to make the sauce.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked vegetables, raw king prawns, and sauce, and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds and chopped green onions over the top of the poke bowl.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
This dish can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, give the poke bowl a good stir and adjust the seasoning as needed.
